steps.eval: (async () => { const {Field} = await import('/src/world/field.js'); const w = Field.world(); const cam = __DQ.state().field.camera; const p = w.player.p; const flat = Math.cos(cam.pitch * Math.PI / 180) * cam.dist, up = Math.sin(cam.pitch * Math.PI / 180) * cam.dist + 0.5; const list = w.cameraRig.fade.objects(900).filter(o => o.kind === 'inst' && o.ghost && o.r > 1.6 && Math.hypot(o.x, o.z) < 28); let best = null; for (const o of list) { const h = Math.max(0.6, o.y - p.y); let back = flat * (h - 0.85) / Math.max(0.5, up - 0.85); back = Math.max(0.9, Math.min(flat - 1.4, back)); const gap = Math.hypot(flat - back, up - h) - o.r; if (gap > 1.4 && (!best || o.r > best.o.r)) best = {o, back, gap}; } if (!best) return 'no canopy fits'; __DQ.teleport('meadow', +(best.o.x).toFixed(2), +(best.o.z - best.back).toFixed(2), 0); __DQ.cameraOrbit(0); __DQ.cameraAuto(false); return JSON.stringify({behind: best.o.name, back: +best.back.toFixed(2), gap: +best.gap.toFixed(2)}); })()
